subject: E-Commerce
title: Counterfeit Crisis
description: A quick, practical guide to Counterfeit Crisis.

hook.text: Amazon comingles inventory in warehouses. A genuine Nike shoe might sit next to a fake in the same bin.

buildup.text: With millions of third-party sellers, policing counterfeits at scale is nearly impossible.

discovery.text: Amazon launched Brand Registry, Project Zero, and Transparency codes to fight fakes. Results are mixed.

twist.text: Some brands pulled off Amazon entirely. Nike left in 2019 to protect its image from counterfeit listings.

climax.text: The counterfeit problem reveals the marketplace tension: openness invites fraud, control limits growth.

punchline.text: Real and fake in the same bin. The marketplace model has a counterfeit cost.

quiz.question: Why did Nike leave Amazon's marketplace?
options: To protect its brand from counterfeit listings
